name: Weird Little Guys
source:
One afternoon, your cat requests a treat. 

Find out what happens next in Weird Little Guys, a choose-your-own-adventure game.

[From [url=https://candacethemagnificent.itch.io/weird-little-guys]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一天下午，你的猫想要吃点东西。

看看怪异小家伙（Weird Little Guys）中接下来会发生什么，这是一款选择你自己的冒险游戏。

[来自[url=https://candacethemagnificent.itch.io/weird-little-guys]itch.io[/url]]
